name: Claude Code usage reader and completeness gate
entrypoint: ClaudeCodeUsageReader.Read; ReadViaSetupToken; RequireCompleteQuotaSnapshot; IsCompleteQuotaSnapshot; TryReadStatusLineQuotaCache; TryWriteQuotaCache; IsQuotaCacheFresh; EnsureStatusLineBridgeInstalled; RunSelfTest
purpose: 读取官方 Claude Code usage/statusline，生成完整额度快照，并统一约束发布、缓存写入与恢复。

reuse: 这是唯一 Claude 额度 reader/completeness gate。setup-token 必须通过严格格式 validator；不得依赖已删除的 ClaudeRadar、社区 URL、模型映射、部分跨窗口状态或公共额度历史。

name: Claude Radar homepage metadata fallback

lifecycle: 退休接口；运行时不读取、不写入、不调度。磁盘遗留不自动销毁，仅供回滚。
reuse: Claude 社区 Radar/模型/缓存链不得复用；CLD 使用 external_api.claude_code.usage 与 internal_api.claude_code_usage_scheduler。

name: Radar runtime diagnostics
purpose: Sample current-process CPU, memory, handle, GDI and USER counters for Radar visual/performance acceptance.

outputs: target process name, pid, scenario label
lifecycle: on-demand CLI only; no resident timer and no window state mutation
reuse: Use this command to collect only-Codex, only-Claude, both-window, high-frequency switching, and suspend/resume performance evidence without changing radar rendering logic. 1.0.3.89 Target-PID mode samples an already-running DesktopCodexAssistant instance and labels report filenames for only-Codex/both-window matrix evidence. 1.0.3.90 CaptureCurrentProcessResources is shared by settings open/close and radar display lifecycle stress tests to keep resource accounting consistent.

name: Radar runtime diagnosis report
purpose: Persist one-shot Radar runtime performance samples for visual/performance acceptance records.
protocol: UTF-8 text and JSON; schema_version=1 for JSON
inputs: target process pid and scenario label
outputs: per-sample cpu_percent working_set private_bytes handle_count gdi_objects user_objects
authentication: current_user_files; no credentials or raw auth responses stored
lifecycle: created on demand; latest text copy is overwritten; timestamped reports are retained until manually cleaned
reuse: Do not store tokens, credentials, command lines containing secrets, or raw network payloads in these reports. 1.0.3.89 Reports include process, pid, and label fields; labels are normalized before being used in filenames.

name: Claude Code Messages rate-limit header fallback
purpose: Retained non-default fallback read of anthropic-ratelimit-unified 5h/7d utilization and reset headers when the OAuth usage JSON path is explicitly re-enabled and incomplete.
protocol: HTTPS POST; JSON body with max_tokens=1; Authorization Bearer OAuth access token; anthropic-version 2023-06-01; anthropic-beta oauth-2025-04-20
authentication: Claude Code OAuth access token; token is never logged or persisted by this app
lifecycle: Not called by the default scheduler after 1.0.4.00. Called only by ClaudeCodeUsageReader.ReadViaSetupToken after the primary OAuth usage endpoint is incomplete, missing reset data, or unavailable.
reuse: Do not call from paint paths or every successful poll. Use only through ClaudeCodeUsageReader so AI request protection, single-flight scheduling, no-body logging, and both-slot validation remain enforced. 1.0.4.00 Keep this out of the default Claude quota path; even a minimal Messages request can spend a tiny amount of Claude quota. Use statusline cache data for normal UI refreshes. 1.0.5.07 仅允许 OAuth 非认证类失败进入本接口；TOKEN_INVALID/401/403 必须短路，避免无效重复和潜在额度消耗。

name: Codex app-server JSONL RPC
purpose: 在额度计划触发或恢复时通过 thread/goal/set 改写用户在普通设置中配置的 Codex goal 状态；保留 thread/list 读取能力供后续维护工具复用。
protocol: JSON-RPC-like newline-delimited stdio; initialize then initialized; no jsonrpc field on the wire; process starts only from a validated signed absolute codex.exe lease
authentication: local Codex auth from user's Codex home; no credentials read or stored by this app
lifecycle: background quota-plan trigger/resume; each operation starts a short-lived app-server process and closes it after the request batch
reuse: 只传 thread ID 与 goal status，不发送提示词、turn 内容、token、Cookie 或凭据。优先发现官方 Codex 安装；环境变量覆盖也必须通过同一绝对路径、位置、reparse point、Authenticode 发布者和打开文件 lease 策略，失败时不启动 app-server。特殊设置窗不刷新或展示 goal 列表。

name: Codex quota goal planner
purpose: 根据 Codex 5 小时和周额度剩余百分比条件，自动截断或恢复普通设置中配置的 Codex goal。
protocol: in-process scheduler plus background app-server RPC
authentication: current user local files and Codex CLI auth
lifecycle: main WidgetForm tick checks at most once per minute; app-server work is background-only and skipped when plan is disabled or quota cache is stale
reuse: Use ShouldTrigger for condition tests. Automatic quota plans must not call AiExternalToolBlocker or kill Codex/Claude processes; process stopping remains manual AI block only. 1.0.3.95 ShouldResume uses CodexQuotaPlanResumeConditionMode so resume can wait for weekly quota, five-hour quota, or both to recover; automatic quota plans still must not stop processes. 1.0.4.54 起，特殊设置窗只允许切换 CodexQuotaPlanEnabled；阈值、恢复条件和 goal ID 列表入口在普通设置 !Codex 额度计划分组，不能再依赖 AiQuickMenuForm.SaveQuotaPlan/RefreshGoals。

name: Codex quota plan state
purpose: 保存额度计划上次触发时由本程序暂停的 goal ID 列表和可选的历史 known_goals 缓存，用于额度恢复自动启用。
protocol: UTF-8 JSON object; schema_version=1; fields known_goals, trigger_active, paused_goal_ids, last_action_utc
authentication: current_user_files; contains only thread IDs and short labels, no prompts or tokens
lifecycle: updated after successful goal refresh and quota-plan status changes; safe to delete to clear remembered goals
reuse: Keep this as small state, not an append-only log. Do not store thread turns, prompt text, credentials, auth tokens, or quota response bodies. 1.0.4.54 起，特殊设置窗不再维护 known_goals 列表；运行时恢复逻辑只依赖 paused_goal_ids 和普通设置中的 goal ID 列表。

name: Claude Code statusline quota cache
purpose: Passive Claude personal quota snapshot written by the Claude Code statusline bridge and read by Desktop Codex Assistant without making Claude API/model requests.
protocol: INI key-value file; Version=1; Source=claude_statusline; complete temporary file committed by same-directory atomic replace/move
inputs: Claude Code statusline JSON on stdin to command.claude_statusline_bridge
authentication: none; contains no token or prompt text
lifecycle: Claude Code 实际渲染 statusline 时写入；scheduler 读取后必须通过完整额度和精确 freshness gate。写入先 flush 完整临时文件，再原子替换，读者不观察半写入额度对。
stability: internal_stable; source JSON fields are external_unstable
reuse: 默认 Claude 个人额度来源之一；不得写入 OAuth token、prompt 或 session 内容。任何发布/缓存回落都必须同时具有两组百分比、两组 reset 和合法 source timestamp。

name: Claude Code statusline bridge script
purpose: Claude Code statusLine command that receives Claude statusline JSON on stdin, extracts rate limit percentages/resets, and writes the local statusline quota cache.
protocol: Claude Code statusLine command; Windows PowerShell 5.1-compatible script; JSON stdin; atomic quota cache output
authentication: none; relies on Claude Code providing its own statusline JSON
lifecycle: 只在无自定义 statusLine 或现有命令属于本 bridge 时安装。settings.json 采用 read-merge-identity-check、最多两次冲突重试和同目录原子提交；持续冲突时 fail closed，绝不覆盖用户并发修改。
stability: internal_stable; Claude Code statusline JSON fields are external_unstable
reuse: 保留未知 settings.json 键、自定义 statusLine 和文件 ACL；不得直接覆盖整个设置文件。bridge 输出不得包含 secret、prompt 或 session 内容。

name: Settings render variant thumbnail picker
purpose: 在设置窗口中用缩略图卡片选择各窗口 RenderVariant 枚举，替代普通下拉并保持实时预览。
protocol: in-process WinForms control
lifecycle: settings window lifetime; sample images are loaded lazily only when owner != null

protocol: PNG files named <prefix>-<variant>.png
lifecycle: 当前 GetVariantSamplePrefix 返回空，设置页不生成或消费该目录。
reuse: 现有 --render-* CLI 直接写用户指定 --out 目录。

name: Codex Radar hidden-mode chrome suppression (removed)
purpose: 历史 Codex Radar 可见 renderer 的隐藏反色边框抑制；当前 headless owner 无可见 chrome，且全局隐藏反色实现已删除。
protocol: removed

name: WidgetSettings user default snapshot

reuse: Only update after backing up settings.ini. Do not promote runtime one-shot counters into nonzero defaults; schema-86 retired DeepSeek/Claude community keys are not defaults.

name: RenderSampleSupport composited current-sample writer
purpose: 渲染采样 current 模式共享助手：把窗口完整 Draw*Window 输出画入透明 ARGB 层，按整窗 alpha 合成到深色壁纸替身底色后保存 PNG，使采样图接近屏幕真实观感。仅测试通道使用，不属于运行时路径。

lifecycle: invoked by --render-* commands only
reuse: 新增窗口的 current 采样必须复用本助手，禁止在各窗口 RenderSample 里手写合成。

name: LayeredWidgetFormBase shared layered-window renderer
entrypoint: LayeredWidgetFormBase.RenderLayeredWindow; ApplyLayerScaleFromSettings; CurrentSettings; ShouldRefreshBurnInPosition; PresentationLuminancePercent; GetActivePresentationLuminancePercent; ComputeOpacityAlpha; DrawWindowContent; ResetDisplayRenderResources
purpose: 共享 layered-window CreateParams、位图/Graphics 生命周期、仅 Alpha 更新、设置存储、像素微迁移 slot、夜间与派生视觉亮度合成、显示恢复和缩放辅助。
protocol: in-process WinForms base class using NativeMethods.LayeredBitmapSurface and GDI+ Bitmap/Graphics
lifecycle: 每个派生窗体持有；缓冲按需创建并在尺寸变化、显示挂起/恢复和关闭时释放；内容重绘后可独立复用位图提交 Alpha；亮度策略变化使原生位图刷新。

name: Claude Code usage shared scheduler

protocol: in-process static scheduler returning Task<ClaudeCodeUsageSchedulerOutcome>
authentication: does not store or log credentials; setup-token presence is only checked as a boolean and token values stay inside ClaudeCodeUsageReader
lifecycle: 由 CodexRadarForm.RefreshClaudeUsageIfNeeded 调用；正常 5 min、失败 10 min、限流 15 min；同轮重叠请求 join；partial 按普通失败退避且不覆盖 last-good。
reuse: All Claude quota refreshes join this scheduler and pass the reader completeness gate; do not create a community/public Radar scheduler.

name: DPAPI local secret store helper
entrypoint: SecretStore.Protect; Unprotect; TryReadOrMigrateSecret; WriteSecret; DeleteSecretFiles; RunSelfTest
purpose: 提供带 dpapi-v1: 明文格式标记的 DPAPI CurrentUser secret envelope、严格验证、原子写入和一次性明文迁移。
protocol: in-process C# API; UTF-8 dpapi-v1:<Base64 DPAPI blob>; same-directory temp plus atomic replace/move; fail-closed format and validator checks
outputs: validated decrypted secret in memory only
legacy plaintext deleted only after durable encrypted commit
authentication: current Windows user DPAPI scope; ciphertext is not portable across users/machines without Windows DPAPI profile material
lifecycle: 本地 secret 读写/清理及 --test fixture 使用；无前缀、坏 Base64、DPAPI 失败、validator 失败和原子提交失败均 fail closed，且失败迁移保留旧明文供重试。

name: Codex Radar notification dedup state

inputs: same-batch coalesced Codex model catalog notification event
lifecycle: read at CodexRadarForm construction; written when a filtered model catalog notification is emitted
reuse: 事件 key 必须是 CodexRadarModelCatalog.NormalizeModelKey 后的模型 key，不得只用显示名去重。该状态只抑制重复通知，不改变 codex-radar-models.ini 目录内容。RunCodexRadarNotificationStateSelfTest 覆盖同批重复、重启重复、删除和删除后再加入。 1.0.4.39 ApplyCodexRadarModelCatalogNotificationState 先对同一 key 的批内冲突事件做 Added > Unavailable > Deleted 合并，再读写本状态文件。

name: Seelen-aware floating window z-order
reuse: 所有非桌面监测窗口必须经 LayeredWidgetFormBase.GetLayeredWidgetInsertAfter；Prepare 先归拢受保护窗口组，进程级 Restore 覆盖全部可见 TopMost 本进程窗口。禁止直接使用 HWND_TOPMOST 绕开 SeelenUI 顺序，也禁止为新浮层扩展固定窗体字段清单。
outputs: HWND insert-after handle for floating windows

lifecycle: used during settings application, positioning and Win+D/Seelen/display recovery; AlwaysVisible reuses foreground WinEvents for immediate repair; no background timer
purpose: Keep protected SeelenUI and optional Codex pet surfaces above this application while placing every visible application TopMost surface above unrelated ordinary or TopMost programs.

name: Elevated CTF input service restart helper

protocol: Windows process command line; ShellExecute runas; current-session ctfmon.exe process enumeration/kill/start/confirmation; shared Logger directory
lifecycle: on-demand from AiQuickMenuForm CTF button in the special settings window; helper bypasses main window mutex path and exits after restart confirmation/failure
reuse: Do not call this command from automated tests because it prompts UAC and can interrupt IME composition. UI code should call Program.RunElevatedCtfmonRestartHelper so launch, wait, exit-code logging and argument sanitization stay centralized. 1.0.4.54 起，该按钮是特殊设置窗三项功能之一，窗口宽度保持不超过 500 px。

name: Operation-panel special settings window
purpose: 在左下角操作面板上方显示宽度不超过 500 px 的特殊设置窗，只提供链接阻断、额度计划开关和 CTF 重启三项快捷功能。
protocol: in-process WinForms no-taskbar owned window; single-click app-settings button opens special settings; double-click opens normal Win11 settings
authentication: current user; CTF restart prompts UAC through helper only
lifecycle: created on operation-panel app-settings single click; reused and foregrounded by WidgetForm.ShowSettingsWindow; disposed on close
reuse: 特殊设置窗只承载三项快捷动作。额度计划详细阈值、恢复条件、暂停 goal 列表和恢复 goal 列表必须在普通 Win11SettingsForm 的 !Codex 额度计划分组维护；不要把 goal 刷新列表、阈值编辑或大型设置页重新放回该窗口。

name: Cloudflare Statuspage v2 API

name: Google Cloud Service Health incidents JSON

reuse: Google Cloud 事件只按公开 incidents feed 和 currently_affected_locations 判断；不要在无登录授权的监控中改用需要项目/组织权限的 Google Cloud 控制台 API。

name: ASUS Keyboard Host battery-care commands

protocol: Windows process start; ASUS Store app execution alias or installed WindowsApps package path
authentication: local_user; vendor utility may enforce its own device and permission checks
lifecycle: Manual operation-panel button; availability checked at startup and by the refresh button; device-specific fallback remains visible but non-destructive.

authentication: local_user; optional UAC when elevated taskkill is requested

name: Windows Segoe icon font resources

name: Radar software mode controller
purpose: Pure decision service for software-family selection and selected official quota refresh targets.

name: Codex Radar family runtime state
entrypoint: RadarFamilyRuntimeState; QuotaRuntimeState; QuotaProtectionState; ApiAlertDebounceRuntimeState; GetRadarFamilyState; GetActiveRadarFamilyState
purpose: 按 family 隔离额度运行态；公共 Radar/模型/IQ 与其刷新 deadline 只归 Codex，Claude family 只持有官方 quota 与服务用量状态。

name: Application window state tracker
purpose: 跟踪顶层窗口、最大化、全屏和遮挡状态；按策略动态启停对象 Hook 与周期完整枚举，并把 WinEvent 先按 HWND 有界合并后交给 UI 线程批量消费。
